dos: Do keep Signal Blue at 10% or less of any viewport.
Do write every label in tracked uppercase mono at 11px or more.
Do prove every value twice: field plus bit diagram.
Do copy the exact visible string.
donts: Don't use pure black, neutral gray, gradients, glows or rounded cards.
Don't use Inter, Space Mono, IBM Plex or serif display.
Don't nest panels or badge the readout.
Don't add motion beyond hover, focus and digit swap.
keyCharacteristics: Bench-instrument density with HUD registration marks.
One accent for selection and live state only.
Chakra Petch readout over JetBrains Mono data.
Flat, square, hairline-ruled; tonal depth, never shadows.
narrative.overview: RadixRef looks like a laboratory bench for bytes: deep diazo-blue ground, steel hairlines, engraved labels and one signal blue meaning live. The tool is the surface.

rules.body: Signal Blue marks selection and live state only.

rules.body: Chakra Petch for readout and display, JetBrains Mono for everything else.
rules.name: The Two-Face Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the bench gets lighter, never higher.
